name: Quadratic
tagline: An AI spreadsheet where cells run real code against live data connections.
description: Quadratic is a from-scratch spreadsheet built on Rust, WASM, and WebGL that pairs AI analysis with real code: cells can execute Python, SQL, and JavaScript, and connect to 25+ sources like Postgres, Snowflake, BigQuery, and QuickBooks. Ask questions in natural language and get working formulas, code, and charts back in the grid.
insight: Its $5.6M seed was led by GV, with pandas creator Wes McKinney and Replit founder Amjad Masad among the angels.
edge: Not a chat bolt-on over a grid: a from-scratch Rust/WASM/WebGL spreadsheet where cells natively execute code beside the AI.
